title: The bandwidth staircase — each tier ~7–9× down
caption: Per-GPU data-movement bandwidth at each hierarchy boundary on H100: on-package HBM3 3.35 TB/s, NVLink 900 GB/s, InfiniBand NDR 50 GB/s, storage ~7 GB/s. Drops of 7.4×, 9× and 7.1× decide which kind of parallelism may live on each tier.

title: Precision is a capacity dial — 350 GB of GPT-3 weights
caption: Devices needed just to hold 175B of weights on 80 GB accelerators: 5 at FP16, 3 at INT8, 2 at INT4. The same silicon spec carries a different nameplate per precision — and the weights fit differently too.
